summary: Expanded one narrow defense supply-chain node around IR optics and chalcogenide glass. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate is LightPath Technologies, which appears unusually close to the node through IR optics, proprietary BlackDiamond glass, optical assemblies, thermal imaging systems, and reported defense/security backlog. Leonardo DRS is a larger but still node-relevant EO/IR systems integrator and customer/supplier-map anchor. Coherent is a larger optical-materials and IR-components reference supplier that may be less pure but useful for supply-chain context. Motorola Solutions is included as a downstream/customer-dependency anchor because external context identifies it as a major LightPath/G5 customer, but its direct chokepoint exposure is weaker and should not crowd out supplier discovery.
